title: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana Crosses 1.3 Crore Registrations Nationwide
source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) / PIB
summary: India's landmark rooftop solar initiative records unprecedented household participation with subsidized installations scaling rapidly across Gujarat, Maharashtra, UP, and Punjab under direct DBT subsidy transfers.

title: CEA Releases National Electricity Plan Addendum: 500 GW Non-Fossil Trajectory on Track
summary: The Central Electricity Authority confirms grid readiness and transmission corridor build-out (Green Energy Corridor Phase II) to evacuate over 200 GW from Western and Southern renewable hubs.

title: Khavda 30 GW Mega Hybrid Renewable Park Commits Additional 3.5 GW Solar Phase
summary: Phase-wise commissioning of the world's largest hybrid renewable power park in Kutch continues ahead of target, integrating automated robotic dry-cleaning to save millions of liters of fresh water.

title: National Green Hydrogen Mission Allocates SIGHT Tranche II Electrolyzer Incentives
source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
summary: SECI awards 1,500 MW/annum domestic electrolyzer manufacturing capacity under the Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition (SIGHT) scheme to bolster supply chain self-reliance.

title: Pumped Storage Hydropower Guidelines Expedite 47 GW Closed-Loop Projects
source: Ministry of Power / Central Electricity Authority
summary: Fast-tracked clearances and environmental flow standardizations unlock major pumped storage hydro assets in Uttarakhand, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, and Himachal Pradesh as grid water batteries.
